name: createCorporateTitle
description: Before creating a Corporate Title, first fetch and display the Salary Grade and Upgrade Level data. The Salary Grade options must be shown to the user, who will then select a name, and the corresponding value must be captured. If the user marks "Top in Hierarchy" as enabled (on), the Next Upgrade Level field should not be displayed. However, if "Top in Hierarchy" is disabled (off), the Next Upgrade Level options must be shown, and the user should select the appropriate value from the list.
